home.description: We offer the best tutoring services to help you excel.
home.mentor_profile: I'm Rafa, I'm a web developer with a background in Business Management and Commercial Engineering, passionate about building digital solutions that are not only technically solid but also strategically impactful. My multidisciplinary experience allows me to bridge the gap between tech and business, understanding real user and market needs. As a tech tutor, I enjoy helping others grow in their tech journey making complex topics easier to understand and inspiring continuous learning.

courses.offer_title: What can I do to help you
courses.offer_description: Teaching since 2021 and business experience since 2018. I'm offering personalized classes for you to learn programming or using platforms that I have extensive experience with from my previous jobs.
courses.web_details: Develop the skills to expertly build a website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, while utilizing industry-leading platforms and tools like GitHub and Bootstrap for advanced development and design.
courses.microsoft_details: Learn to master Microsoft tools perfectly. Create documentation in Word, high-quality presentations in PowerPoint, or advanced Excel spreadsheets to manage, present, or handle data efficiently.
courses.softwares_details: Master valuable platforms for the IT job market such as Power BI, Jira, Hubspot, Miro, Basecamp, among many others. I can teach you the importance of platforms to empower your IT work.

portfolio.title: Welcome to my portfolio!
portfolio.subtitle: Here, you’ll find a collection of web design and development projects that showcase my passion for creating clean, functional, and visually engaging websites. Each project reflects my commitment to providing innovative solutions tailored to the unique needs of my clients. Whether it's building responsive websites, crafting user-friendly interfaces, or implementing cutting-edge technologies, my goal is to deliver exceptional results that enhance the user experience and drive success.
